name: Lon Hill
source:
The genius scholar at St. Elmo's academy. He was born into the ancient knight family, the Hills. His family recommended he participate in research for magical creatures since he was young. His father is the head knight; he loves hearing his parents talk about the stories they heard. He is childhood friends with Craig. 

He accidentally stumbled into the land of magical creatures when he was a kid and witnessed an extraordinary scene, which infused his curiosity for magical creatures.

He likes to write scripts in his spare time and hopes one day he will be able to write a story demonstrating the truth of this world.

[Edited from in-game bio]
